classical_algorithm: RSA-PSS with SHA-256 and X25519 ECDH
cryptographic_operation: Provision RSA backup manifest signer identities
migration_objective: Replace RSA signer generation with ML-DSA-65 key pairs.
preconditions: Backup owners and snapshot contents are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only the matching active owner can restore a backup encrypted to that owner.
Backup generations increase monotonically and duplicate IDs fail.
The signed manifest authenticates owner, generation, and ciphertext digest.
migration_requirements: Use ML-DSA-65 with a BackupVault manifest context.
Use ML-KEM-768 with HKDF-SHA-256 and AES-256-GCM for recipient encryption.
Update serialized key formats and integrations without classical fallback.
verification_procedure: Run baseline and PQC suites independently.
Test snapshot roundtrip, generation rollback, wrong owner, inactive owner, missing backup, duplicate ID, and serialization.
known_limitations: Synthetic backup service only; not an enterprise backup or disaster-recovery certification.
